item.title: An Atlas a day!
item.description:
I wish I could take a note from the boy and just shake this all off. I swear to dog, if I am handed one more battle, I will quite simply lose my mind. It’s hardly tethered as it is.
While he was being a silly goose yesterday and rolling around on the futon next to me, I noticed one of his molars looked weird. I looked closer and it was definitely broken. Compared it to the one on the other side and confirmed it’s a substantial break. I don’t know when or how he did it, but it looks like the root is exposed. His appetite does not seem to be suffering and he’s showing no signs of pain. But just because he’s not showing pain, doesn’t mean it doesn’t hurt. And I don’t want to risk an infection. Especially not while I’m under the knife or stuck in the hospital. Fortunately, my vet can squeeze us in tomorrow to look at it and decide what we need to do next. I literally JUST paid off his medical bills for when he got himself quilled back in April. I needed that space on my care credit card to pay off the mountain of medical bills I’ve accumulated already from my upcoming excision surgery and whatever I’ll owe afterwards. Now I need to find room elsewhere to pay for this. I imagine they will have to extract the tooth because of how bad it’s broken. I don’t even want to think of what it’s going to cost on top of everything else. Between the two of us, I’m drowning in medical debt. I’m just completely fried because of my own medical stuff and everything else life is throwing at us. I am his keeper and it is my responsibility to make sure he is safe and happy and healthy no matter what. But holy fuck, this is just another massive hurdle. I’m not going to be able to drive for the first two weeks after I get out of surgery, so I’m going to need to find someone who can drive us to the vet if he needs dental surgery. When it rains, it pours, and it looks like both of us will be recovering from surgery together. JFC. A couple folks have reached out to ask about helping financially. I deeply, deeply appreciate the generosity. I just feel like there are so many people and groups suffering worse than me and if you’re going to donate money, it should be to something more worthy. I’m trying to take as many side gigs as I can this week, on top of prepping food, cleaning and disinfecting the apartment, and making sure everything is set for work. I’m going to try and make some art while in recovery that I will try to sell. I successfully sold a bunch of butt paintings a few years ago. People like butts, so I’ll give the people what they want and hope to dog that they want to pay for pretty butts. I’ll paint boobs too, because who doesn’t like those. I’m just so fucking tired. I’m in the negative in regard to capacity for literally anything.
Some aforementioned butts. Much love, from the kids who might not be alright. But we will make it, especially together.
